content.user_title: Analyze Options and Warrants with Longbridge
content.value_statement: Derivatives data can be difficult to compare across contracts, expiries, and volatility measures. This skill organizes Longbridge data into clear options and warrant analysis.
actual_capabilities: Retrieves option quotes, chains, and volume data for supported HK and US markets through Longbridge.
Explains implied volatility, Delta, Gamma, Theta, Vega, volume, and open interest.
Maps an underlying, expiry, strike, and option type to an OCC contract symbol.
Calculates expiry payoffs, breakevens, maximum profit, maximum loss, and net Greeks for option positions.
Compares implied and historical volatility, then summarizes volatility smiles and skew.
Lists and interprets HK warrants, CBBC products, quotes, leverage, premiums, and issuers.
limitations: Live results require an available Longbridge CLI or compatible MCP data tool.
US options data requires appropriate US market access, and warrants are limited to Hong Kong markets.
Historical volatility and IV percentile estimates can be approximate when historical IV data is unavailable.
The skill provides analysis and education, but it does not place or manage trades.

use_cases.title: Review an option chain
use_cases.description: Compare strikes, calls, puts, implied volatility, Greeks, volume, and open interest for a selected expiry.

use_cases.title: Assess a volatility setup
use_cases.description: Compare implied and historical volatility, inspect skew, and evaluate suitable defined-risk structures.

use_cases.title: Screen Hong Kong warrants
use_cases.description: Review listed warrants or CBBC products by underlying, issuer, leverage, implied volatility, and premium.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize an option chain
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the option chain for [symbol] and list available expiries. Summarize the nearest expiry, important strikes, and call-put activity.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect one option contract
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the [call or put] for [symbol], expiring [date], with strike [price]. Explain its quote, IV, Greeks, volume, and open interest.

prompt_templates.title: Compare strategy choices
prompt_templates.prompt: I expect [symbol] to be [bullish, bearish, or neutral] over [time horizon]. Compare two defined-risk strategies using current Longbridge options data.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate volatility structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [symbol] across near and far expiries. Compare ATM IV, 60-day HV, term structure, and 25-Delta skew, then assess a calendar or diagonal spread.

output_examples.input: Show the nearest AAPL option expiry and explain the at-the-money contracts.
output_examples.output: The response lists the nearest expiry, identifies nearby call and put strikes, and compares premiums, IV, Greeks, volume, and open interest.

output_examples.input: Calculate the expiry payoff for my two-leg bull call spread.
output_examples.output: The response presents both legs, net cost, breakeven, maximum profit, maximum loss, and a payoff table around the current price.

output_examples.input: Compare Hong Kong warrants for an underlying.
output_examples.output: The response summarizes available products by issuer, type, leverage, implied volatility, premium, and relevant liquidity constraints.

best_practices: Provide the market suffix, preferred expiry, strike range, and call or put preference.
Confirm timestamps and liquidity before relying on quoted prices, volatility, or open interest.
State your time horizon and risk limits when requesting strategy comparisons.
anti_patterns: Do not treat estimated IV percentile or model-derived Greeks as exact values.
Do not use stale or illiquid quotes as reliable execution prices.
Do not interpret educational strategy analysis as personalized investment advice.

faq.question: Which markets are supported?
faq.answer: The skill covers supported HK and US options. Warrants and CBBC products are available only for Hong Kong underlyings.

faq.question: Does the skill require a Longbridge login?
faq.answer: Option and warrant commands are described as public. Some US market data still requires appropriate market access.

faq.question: Can it find a contract without an OCC symbol?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the underlying, expiry, strike, and call or put type so the skill can search the option chain.

faq.question: Can it calculate a multi-leg payoff?
faq.answer: Yes. It can summarize legs, breakevens, maximum profit, maximum loss, payoff points, and net Greeks.

faq.question: How is volatility evaluated?
faq.answer: The skill compares option-chain IV with historical volatility and examines term structure, smile, and skew.

faq.question: Does it execute trades?
faq.answer: No. It retrieves data and provides educational analysis. It does not submit, modify, or manage orders.
